threat_event: An attacker uses a leaked static key to read and copy payroll handoff files and customer exports from the export bucket
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Static keys with read on all tenant prefixes; no data-plane read logging; no bulk-read alert
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (FTC Start with Security 3; 5); SOC 2 CC6.1
existing_controls: Encryption at rest; secret scanning of group repositories
treatment_plan: Revoke static keys; workload identity; read logging and bulk-read alerts (POAM-001, POAM-003, POAM-008)

threat_event: A tenant isolation defect exposes one customer's worker data to another customer
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared database clusters with tenant-scoped roles; isolation enforced in code and roles
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (FTC Start with Security 5); SOC 2 CC6.1
existing_controls: Isolation tests in every release; tenant-scoped roles; bug bounty
treatment_plan: Add tenant isolation checks to the canary stage; annual third-party isolation test

threat_event: Handoff files kept far beyond need multiply the size of any breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No lifecycle rule; files back to 2025-08; neither division owns the data
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (FTC Start with Security 1); N52-R03 (16 CFR 314.4(c)(6))
existing_controls: Encryption with provider-managed keys
treatment_plan: Delete files older than 7 days after payroll confirms receipt; move the channel to the payroll engine (POAM-006, POAM-007)

threat_event: A consultant's implementation-partner access to a customer tenant is used after the project ends
threat_source: Insider or attacker using a consultant identity
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Partner roles not removed at project close; not in certification
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (FTC Start with Security 2); DPA terms
existing_controls: SSO with MFA; access logged
treatment_plan: Expire partner roles at project close; include in quarterly certification (POAM-015)

threat_event: A prompt injection in tenant content makes the workforce assistant reveal data the user should not see
threat_source: Malicious insider at a customer; external attacker
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Assistant retrieves tenant data on the user's behalf; no adversarial testing
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (FTC Start with Security 7); SOC 2 CC6.1
existing_controls: Retrieval limited to the user's permissions; output filters for Social Security and bank numbers
treatment_plan: Red-team testing before each model change (POAM-011)

threat_event: Attrition-risk scores disadvantage protected groups and customers rely on them in employment decisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Features such as tenure and absence patterns can act as proxies for age, disability, or caregiving; no bias testing; no developer documentation for deployers
regulatory_driver: Colo. SB26-189 (developer duties from 2027-01-01); N51-R01 (unfairness); customer ADMT duties (N51-R03)
existing_controls: Score explanations shown to managers; feature off by default
treatment_plan: Bias testing by protected-class proxies; developer documentation; usage guidance that scores must not be the sole basis for decisions (POAM-027)

threat_event: Customers or the FTC treat AI tuning on aggregated customer data as a broken data-use promise
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 3,400 pre-2023 DPAs do not mention aggregated data use; public page says data is used only to provide the service
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (deception: data-use statements); N51-R03 (Cal. Civ. Code 1798.140, service provider)
existing_controls: Data use catalog; de-identification before tuning
treatment_plan: Stop using pre-2023 customers' data for tuning until amended; update the trust center statement (POAM-012)

threat_event: A customer incident notice is sent after the 48-hour or 72-hour DPA deadline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Matrix lacks the 1,240 customers with 48-hour terms; no exercise
regulatory_driver: DPA terms; N51-R01 (FTC Data Breach Response guide)
existing_controls: Notice templates; support contact lists
treatment_plan: Add contract clocks per customer to the matrix; tabletop (POAM-004)
owner: Cloud Software customer support vice president

threat_event: A bank customer is not notified within the bank service provider rule
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 164 of about 420 bank customers have not provided a designated contact
existing_controls: Account manager contact lists
treatment_plan: Collect designated contacts; default to the rule's fallback contacts (POAM-004)
owner: Cloud Software customer support vice president

threat_event: Ransomware or a destructive attack deletes WCP databases and backups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Administrative access through shared identity
regulatory_driver: SOC 2 A1.2; MSA availability
existing_controls: Immutable backups in provider B; separate backup identity; PAM
treatment_plan: Keep; annual restore of a full region from the vault

threat_event: A customer administrator account is taken over and used to export all worker data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MFA required for administrators, but some customers federate from identity providers without MFA
regulatory_driver: SOC 2 CC6.1; complementary user entity controls
existing_controls: Required MFA for WCP administrator accounts; export notifications to administrators
treatment_plan: Require MFA claims from federated identity providers for administrator roles

threat_event: A worker account is taken over and the direct deposit account is changed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Workers often use weak passwords and SMS codes
regulatory_driver: SOC 2 CC6.1; state wage payment laws (generic)
existing_controls: Re-authentication for bank changes; anomaly scoring by payroll
treatment_plan: Second-channel notice of bank changes; passkeys for workers

threat_event: A denial-of-service attack makes the WCP unavailable at shift change
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Internet-facing APIs and time clocks
regulatory_driver: MSA availability; SOC 2 A1.2
existing_controls: Provider DDoS protection; WAF; rate limits
treatment_plan: Annual DDoS test with the provider

threat_event: A regional outage lasts longer than the RTO, and payroll misses its cutoff because the handoff is not recovered first
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Joint recovery with the payroll engine never tested
regulatory_driver: SOC 2 A1.3; MSA availability
existing_controls: Warm standby region; yearly failover test
treatment_plan: Joint failover test including the handoff (POAM-014)

threat_event: A vulnerable open-source component in the API is exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large dependency tree
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (FTC Start with Security 9)
existing_controls: Dependency scanning; 15-day fix target for Critical
treatment_plan: Keep; reachability analysis to prioritize fixes

threat_event: A support agent browses tenant data without a business need
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large support organization
regulatory_driver: SOC 2 CC6.3; DPA terms
existing_controls: Ticket-linked, tenant-scoped support access; monthly access sampling
treatment_plan: Keep; automated alerts for access without an open ticket

threat_event: The model provider retains or exposes prompts despite zero-retention terms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: External dependency outside the landing zone
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (FTC Start with Security 8); DPA sub-processor terms
existing_controls: Zero-retention terms; prompt filters for Social Security and bank numbers
treatment_plan: Annual assurance review and right-to-audit clause (POAM-013)

threat_event: A new sub-processor is added without the 30-day notice the DPA requires
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Product teams can enable vendors before legal review
regulatory_driver: DPA terms; N51-R01 (FTC Start with Security 8)
existing_controls: Sub-processor review procedure
treatment_plan: Block vendor enablement in procurement until notice clears

threat_event: Data of terminated customers is kept past the 90-day deletion promise
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Deletion is a manual job
regulatory_driver: DPA terms; N51-R01 (FTC Start with Security 1)
existing_controls: Monthly deletion job with sign-off
treatment_plan: Automate deletion with evidence for SOC 2 C1.2

threat_event: Application logs contain worker personal data and are kept longer than needed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Some error messages include names and phone numbers
regulatory_driver: DPA terms
existing_controls: Log scrubbing library
treatment_plan: Extend scrubbing to all services

threat_event: A broken object-level authorization flaw lets a user read another worker's records in the same tenant
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Many API endpoints
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (FTC Start with Security 7)
existing_controls: Bug bounty; dynamic testing
treatment_plan: Authorization test generation in the pipeline

threat_event: The CI/CD pipeline is compromised and malicious code is deployed to the WCP
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared pipeline
regulatory_driver: SOC 2 CC8.1
existing_controls: Signed builds; protected branches
treatment_plan: Build provenance attestations

threat_event: A customer's API token is stolen and used to bulk-export worker data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Long-lived customer API tokens
regulatory_driver: SOC 2 CC6.1; complementary user entity controls
existing_controls: Token scopes; rate limits
treatment_plan: Expiring tokens by default; anomaly alerts to customer administrators

threat_event: An engineer's laptop is lost or stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Mobile workforce
regulatory_driver: SOC 2 CC6.8
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption; remote wipe; no customer data on laptops by policy
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Cloud Software division CISO (Low)

threat_event: The schedule optimizer gives fewer hours or worse shifts to protected groups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Optimizer uses availability and past performance signals
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (unfairness); customer contracts
existing_controls: Managers approve every schedule
treatment_plan: Disparity monitoring by customer-provided demographics where available (P10)

threat_event: Security questionnaire answers to prospects overstate controls
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Sales uses an answer library that is not reviewed against current controls
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (deception)
existing_controls: Answer library owned by the division CISO
treatment_plan: Quarterly review of the answer library against P07 results

threat_event: Another storage location is made public by mistake
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Many buckets across accounts
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (FTC Start with Security 4)
existing_controls: Guardrail blocks public access
treatment_plan: Keep; monthly exception review

threat_event: Workforce assistant summaries of HR case notes reach managers who lack HR permissions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Summaries draw on case notes visible to HR roles
regulatory_driver: DPA terms; N51-R01 (unfairness)
existing_controls: Case notes excluded for non-HR roles by default
treatment_plan: Permission tests for every retrieval source (POAM-010)
